selected_evidence.requirement: Real topology discovery (node1 routes node2<->node3, not the flat default net initially observed)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed node1 has 3 NICs (eth0/eth1/eth2) and node2/node3 each have an unconfigured eth1; firewalld showed eth1 present, revealing the intended private-network topology

selected_evidence.requirement: Static addressing and routing configured so node2<->node3 traffic actually transits node1
selected_evidence.summary: Assigned IPs on node1 eth1/eth2, node2/node3 eth1, added static routes; ping node2->node3 showed TTL=63 confirming one-hop routing via node1
iperf3 measured ~21.7 Gbit/s node2->node3 and ~21.6 Gbit/s node3->node2 before any shaping was applied

selected_evidence.requirement: Apply 1 Mbit/s limit on node2->node3 traffic only, leaving node3->node2 unrestricted
selected_evidence.summary: Configured VyOS QoS shaper (bandwidth/ceiling 1mbit) as egress on node1 eth2 (node3-facing interface); tc class show confirmed 'rate 1Mbit ceil 1Mbit'; iperf3 showed node2->node3 throttled to ~1.13 Mbit/s while node3->node2 stayed at ~1.54 Gbit/s

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state (QoS shaping, forwarding)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 5bcff8f9..., issued reboot, node became unreachable then reachable again with new boot_id b41c3968..., and post-restart eth1/eth2 addressing, ip_forward=1, and the 1Mbit HTB class on eth2 were all confirmed intact

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state (addressing, routes, firewall)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 54bd1c3e... captured, reboot triggered, node came back with new boot_id 25322907..., and eth1 IP/route to 10.10.13.0/24 and firewalld 'trusted' zone on eth1 all persisted

selected_evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state (addressing, routes, firewall)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e31962a9... captured, reboot triggered, node came back with new boot_id 40c231ca..., eth1 IP/route to 10.10.12.0/24 and firewalld 'trusted' zone persisted

selected_evidence.requirement: End-to-end functional recovery of the traffic-shaping requirement after all three restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart iperf3 confirmed node2->node3 still capped (~1.27 Mbit/s) and node3->node2 still unrestricted (~1.17 Gbit/s)
